Title: attn LSJ: Question about Heidelberg, others...

Messages.Author: PC Handyman
Messages.Body:
Is there an opportunity to tap the heidelberg castle after a minion has
successfully blocked, but before the ensuing combat? (to switch the
intercept provider to another minion)

Is it legitimate to contest a card with oneself for a turn then concede it,
just to cycle a card?

Thanks...

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <6imdt1$4...@bolivia.earthlink.net>#1/1,

"PC Handyman" <pchan...@earthlink.net> wrote:
>
> Is there an opportunity to tap the heidelberg castle after a minion has
> successfully blocked, but before the ensuing combat? (to switch the
> intercept provider to another minion)

No. You can tap HC before the block is successful, however.
If you use HC to move a Sport Bike away from the blocking minion and
that reduction in intercept leaves him with less intercept than
the acting minion's stealth, the block will fail.

> Is it legitimate to contest a card with oneself for a turn then concede it,
> just to cycle a card?

You can contest a card with yourself, but you'll contest it for longer
than you think, and it'll cost you a pool:

1. Put second copy into play - contest.
2. Next untap, pay one pool for the copy you wish to keep, yield the other.
3. On your following untap, you get control of the unyielded copy.
